ValidationRule.description: CC-1882: Restrict Modify Referrer Email/Name when the Status is Not as In Progress.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In progress')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Opportunity Identified')), OR( ISCHANGED( Referrer_Email__c), ISCHANGED( Referrer_Name__c) ) )
